title: A power of the vanishing ideal kills a coherent module
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], T a closed subset, and F a coherent module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with its nonzero module-stalk locus [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] contained in T. Then some nonnegative power of the actual vanishing ideal of T acting on F, formed by idealModuleProduct and idealSheafPower, is a zero object.

proof.text: Coherence implies quasi-coherence and finite type. Cover X by finitely many affine opens. finite_type_module_support_closed identifies support locally with V(Ann M); quasi_coherent_ideal_zero_set_affine identifies the vanishing ideal zero locus with T. Containment gives J(U) contained in radical(Ann M). Apply Mathlib Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg using Noetherian finite generation, and take the maximum exponent (zero for an empty cover).

The local ideal_qc helper uses closed-immersion pushforward and kernel quasi-coherence. The generalized multiplication_range requires only quasi-coherence of the target and tensor object and surjectivity of the affine tensor comparison, not quasi-coherence of the source. powers_affine_sections treats an arbitrary quasi-coherent module morphism i to the unit, with no monicity or ideal-sheaf hypothesis: it proves quasi-coherence and range(i^n) = range(i)^n for every exponent, including zero. The generalized powerProduct_isZero_iff_affine_cover gives vanishing of its product with F exactly when those affine ideals annihilate F. affine_source_zero_of_sections applies to any open immersion from an affine scheme, not only the canonical inclusion of an affine open; use the affine tilde-Gamma equivalence and sheaf locality. Specialize i to the vanishing-ideal inclusion and identify its range using range_toModulesι_app. The two existing affine-product packages reach the item and cannot be imported without a cycle.

proof_origin.based_on: Affine support and annihilator argument from Stacks Tag 01Y9; repair removes duplicate helpers and generalizes affine powers and vanishing to arbitrary unit-valued module maps and arbitrary affine source open immersions.

theorem coherent_support_vanishingIdeal_nilpotence
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (T : TopologicalSpace.Closeds X)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F)
    (hSupp : {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton (F.presheaf.stalk x)} ⊆ (T : Set X)) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, IsZero (idealModuleProduct
      (idealSheafPower (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal T).toModulesι n).2 F)
